title: JD.com Open-Sources Real-Time Video Editing Model: 30 Frames per Second Inference, Watching and Editing Videos Simultaneously Redefining Video Creation

content_html:
Jingdong has announced the open-source of its self-developed real-time streaming video editing model JoyAI-Video-Edit. Users can modify characters and scenes while watching videos, transforming video creation from "editing after having materials" to real-time interactive editing. Jingdong's official stated that this model comprehensively outperforms current industry representative models in real-time streaming video editing, reaching world-class standards.

Real-time video editing first needs to solve the speed issue. Videos are made up of continuous frames, and if the model's processing speed cannot keep up with the playback speed, lag and delay will occur. JoyAI-Video-Edit is based on the fully self-developed JoyAI-Video model, achieving a model inference speed of 30 frames per second at 720P resolution. It can maintain high image clarity while keeping up with the playback rhythm of common films and videos.

Video length is also a barrier for streaming editing. Previously, streaming editing models could only handle seconds or minute-level segments, but JoyAI-Video-Edit supports stable streaming editing of any duration, allowing continuous processing as the video plays. Users don't need to wait for the entire video to be generated before they can make real-time changes to scenes, replace objects, adjust character appearances, or change the visual style, achieving "create while watching."

Comprehensive authoritative evaluation, outstanding advantages in four types of editing tasks

To evaluate the model's capabilities, the research team compared JoyAI-Video-Edit with international representative streaming video editing models such as SANA Streaming, LiveEdit, and Xmax-X2.0. The results showed that JoyAI-Video-Edit comprehensively outperformed others in evaluation data covering typical video editing scenarios.

In the industry's authoritative OpenVE-Bench general evaluation, this model surpassed all current streaming editing methods, especially excelling in global style, local replacement, local deletion, and subtitle editing tasks, significantly outperforming industry peers. In specific application scenarios, creators can let characters continuously change clothes in the video, transform ordinary streets into animated worlds during live streams, or try different furniture, wall colors, and lighting effects in home design.

Not just video creation, but also producing training data for robots

Notably, JoyAI-Video-Edit also provides a new technical path for large-scale synthesis of embodied intelligence data. Robot training requires a large amount of video about object grasping, moving, and operation, but real machine data collection is costly, and dangerous or rare scenarios are difficult to collect repeatedly.

With controllable editing capabilities over scenes, objects, and visual content, JoyAI-Video-Edit can convert manually operated videos into mechanical hand or arm operation materials. It can retain the position of objects, spatial relationships, and action trajectories while replacing scenes, objects, and robot forms, expanding a single video into more training samples. From video creation to robot training data synthesis, the open-sourcing of this model may open up new possibilities across multiple fields.

content_html_zh:
京东宣布开源其自主研发的实时流媒体视频编辑模型JoyAI-Video-Edit。 用户可以在观看视频的同时修改人物和场景，将视频创作从“有素材后编辑”转变为实时互动编辑。 京东官方表示，该机型在实时流媒体视频编辑方面全面超越目前行业代表性机型，达到世界一流水平。

实时视频编辑首先需要解决速度问题。 视频是由连续的帧组成的，如果模型的处理速度跟不上播放速度，就会出现滞后和延迟。 JoyAI-Video-Edit基于完全自主研发的JoyAI-Video模型，在720P分辨率下实现了每秒30帧的模型推理速度。 它可以保持较高的图像清晰度，同时跟上常见电影和视频的播放节奏。

视频长度也是流媒体编辑的一个障碍。 此前，流媒体编辑模型只能处理秒或分钟级别的片段，而JoyAI-Video-Edit支持任意时长的稳定流媒体编辑，可以在视频播放时连续处理。 用户无需等待整个视频生成，就可以实时更改场景、替换对象、调整角色外观或改变视觉风格，实现“边看边创作”。

综合权威评测，四类编辑任务优势突出

为了评估模型的能力，研究团队将JoyAI-Video-Edit与SANA Streaming、LiveEdit、Xmax-X2.0等国际代表性流媒体视频编辑模型进行了比较。 结果显示，JoyAI-Video-Edit在覆盖典型视频编辑场景的评测数据上全面领先其他厂商。

在业界权威的OpenVE-Bench综合评测中，该模型超越了目前所有的流媒体编辑方式，尤其在全局样式、本地替换、本地删除、字幕编辑任务上表现出色，明显优于业界同行。 在具体的应用场景中，创作者可以让视频中的人物不断更换衣服，在直播中将普通的街道变成动画世界，或者在家居设计中尝试不同的家具、墙壁颜色和灯光效果。

不仅仅是视频创作，还为机器人制作训练数据

值得注意的是，JoyAI-Video-Edit还为大规模合成具身智能数据提供了一条新的技术路径。 机器人训练需要大量物体抓取、移动、操作等视频，但实机数据采集成本高，危险或罕见场景难以重复采集。

JoyAI-Video-Edit具备对场景、物体、视觉内容的可控编辑能力，可以将手动操作的视频转换为机械手或机械臂操作素材。 它可以保留物体的位置、空间关系和动作轨迹，同时替换场景、物体和机器人形态，将单个视频扩展为更多的训练样本。 从视频创作到机器人训练数据合成，该模型的开源可能会在多个领域开辟新的可能性。
